title: AI-generated election information and voter trust
discussion_signal: The post highlights a trust problem when voters use AI to fact-check political information while not knowing whether the information itself is AI-generated. It also points to public-service use cases for election logistics, making provenance and correction capacity central to legitimacy.
linked_research_question: When political information is mediated by AI, what makes voters able to authenticate, correct, and locally explain it?
limits: Single public post and linked discussion
Does not measure voter prevalence or electoral effects
The post’s claims require direct comparison with the cited study and election data
